versions.content: {DRAFT} If UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is TRUE , the PNI bit in the received NM - PDU is set to 1 and the PNSR bit is set to 1, UdpNm module shall extract the PNC bit vector from the received NM - PDU according to the partial ne twork configuration ( NmPncBitVectorOffset and NmPncBitVectorLength of the corresponding NM - channel) and forward the PNC bit vector by calling Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown .
